messages:
greenfield-billing: Hi team — we just noticed Greenfield Analytics was billed twice for the same renewal. Two invoices, same period, one for 2026-03-01, one for 2026-03-01 but different invoice IDs. Can you help?
maya (Support): Sorry — looking now. Can you paste the two invoice IDs and the account id?
greenfield-billing: INV-2026-0045 and INV-2026-0046, account gf-9842. The amounts are identical, tax lines differ slightly (VAT recalculation).
maya (Support): thx. I see two successful charge events in our payments log. One has a webhook retry noted. Copying logs below.
maya (Support): ```
payments.log:
1969012339 CHARGE success id=ch_1A2B3 INV=INV-2026-0045 acct=gf-9842 amount=125000 tax=12500
1969012341 CHARGE success id=ch_1A2B4 INV=INV-2026-0046 acct=gf-9842 amount=125000 tax=0
webhook.delivery: payload_id=pl_7X retry_count=2 status=200
```
liam (Finance): Looks like tax calculation changed mid-flow. Did the customer update VAT id and trigger an invoice adjustment? If so, our invoice reissue path should void prior invoice before charging.
maya (Support): Customer says they updated VAT settings right before renewal window. I can see a tax-recalc webhook from tax-service at 1969012338 then invoice.reissued at 1969012339.
arjun (billing-eng): tagging in. This might be idempotency key mismatch between reissue and charge flow. Can you share the gateway request payloads (ids redacted) for both charges?
maya (Support): dropping gateway debug: ```
REQUEST A: {"idempotency_key":"acct-gf-9842-renewal-20260301","invoice_id":"INV-2026-0045","amount":125000}
REQUEST B: {"idempotency_key":"acct-gf-9842-renewal-20260301-reissue","invoice_id":"INV-2026-0046","amount":125000}
```
arjun (billing-eng): aha — the idempotency key changed when we issued the reissued invoice. Gateway treated as separate charge. Our intended flow is to cancel original charge or reuse same idempotency key for reissues. This is a bug in the reissue adapter.
liam (Finance): For remediation: we need to refund one charge and issue reversal on the duplicate invoice. Which charge should we refund? The one with tax=0 (INV-2026-0046) or the earlier? Customer prefers we refund the later one and keep the invoice with correct VAT.
maya (Support): Confirming customer preference: keep INV-2026-0045 (tax=12500) and refund INV-2026-0046.
liam (Finance): I'll create a refund. I'll also request a manual credit note against INV-2026-0046. Processing now.
liam (Finance): refund created ref=rf_90321 amount=125000 status=pending. Will update when settled.
stripe-bot: Payment refund rf_90321 succeeded for ch_1A2B4 at 1969012930.
maya (Support): Refund succeeded. Customer notified and asked for confirmation email.
maya (Support): Next steps for engineering: @arjun can you open a PR to align idempotency behavior on reissued invoices so reissues reuse original payment idempotency or cancel previous charge flow? Also add a check in webhook worker to avoid immediate retry on reissue events.
arjun (billing-eng): Received. Will triage and target a hotfix this week. Root cause ticket: BILL-1179. Also adding an alert for "invoice.reissue without cancel" pattern.
maya (Support): OK closing loop with customer: refund processed, we've set a credit note for INV-2026-0046, and engineering is working on a fix. Apologies for the disruption :pray:
greenfield-billing: Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround. Can you CC our accounting contact on the refund confirmation? email: accounting@greenfield.ai
maya (Support): Done — email sent with refund receipt and credit note. Let us know if anything else.
